body.intent: Fix A run interrupted after its change set landed can never be resumed: rhiza run resume and the daemon's resume both require the change set to be accepted (run.go resume guard, daemon Resumable's accepted check), so a ship-change run stopped at wait-main or close-out (or a plan run after its record landed) is stranded and must be abandoned and closed out by hand. Allow resuming a run whose change set landed when its remaining steps are post-land ones (wait-main, close-out and later), and let the daemon resume those headless
